generalItems.q: What is Barosec Secure and how can I benefit from it?
generalItems.a: Barosec Secure plans help you maximize your security experience with alerts powered by Barosec Intelligence and tools to help you act quickly during an emergency from anywhere. You can record up to 4K resolution video (requires devices with 4K capability), get detailed alerts that tell you who's at your door, whose vehicle is in the driveway, or when an animal or package has been detected by your camera.

generalItems.q: How do I subscribe to an Barosec Secure plan?
generalItems.a: The best way to subscribe is by logging in to your account at my.barosec.com, tap or click Settings > Subscriptions, and then selecting a plan that best fits your needs.

generalItems.q: Is an Barosec Secure plan required to use my Barosec gallary?
generalItems.a: No. You can still use your Barosec product with certain features, but a plan helps you get the most out of your devices with smart features like Interactive Notifications and emergency response tools.

generalItems.q: Can I share my camera access with family or friends?
generalItems.a: Yes. You can grant access to family or friends.

generalItems.q: I have an Barosec Home Security System, which plan is right for me?
generalItems.a: The best plan for Barosec Home Security System owners is the Premium with Professional Monitoring.

generalItems.q: I have Barosec gallary at more than one address. Can one Barosec Secure subscription cover them all?
generalItems.a: No. You'll need to subscribe to a separate Barosec Secure plan for each address you want to protect.

trialItems.q: Is there a trial of an Barosec Secure Plan?
trialItems.a: Yes! A free 30-day trial of Barosec Secure is included for each new Barosec Camera, Video Doorbell, Floodlight, or Home Security System product. Some gallary sold by authorized retailers may include a promotion for a longer duration.

trialItems.q: When does my Barosec Secure trial start?
trialItems.a: Your Barosec Secure trial begins as soon as you complete onboarding the product in the Barosec Secure App.

trialItems.q: What happens when my Barosec Secure Trial ends?
trialItems.a: After trial, you can subscribe to an Barosec Secure plan at my.barosec.com to keep premium features like 60-Day Video History, Activity Zones, Interactive Alerts, 24/7 Emergency Response, and more.
